changelog:
No code changes; added secrets and permissions blocks:

- Declared required secrets (`WEBHOOK_TOKEN`, optionally `OPENCLAW_HOOKS_TOKEN`) for webhook authentication.
- Added explicit permissions for HTTP webhooks (incoming game events) and HTTP REST calls (game actions) to among-traitors-api.fly.dev.
- No functional changes to agent/game logic.
summary: Control an AI game agent in Among Traitors by birthing, joining lobbies with webhooks, and guiding gameplay through card plays and whispers via REST API.
